title: OpenAI is sharpening its focus on enterprise advertisers
description: The company is hiring a dedicated marketing role aimed at positioning OpenAI as a 'premium advertising platform for the world’s marketers'.

title: The new AI playbook: The rules brands are setting around customer-facing content
description: For some brands, AI platforms and services are proving to be game-changing for their ability to speed up creative processes, and save money.

title: The IAB is developing a framework to tackle AI advertising measurement
description: The IAB is developing a framework to solve a big challenge in advertising: how to measure and assign credit when ads influence AI agents.

title: Hershey is using AI to strategize for s’mores season
description: The Hershey Company has started using new AI tools to maximize sales performance of s'mores ingredients in stores — including its own chocolates, as well as marshmallows and graham crackers.

title: Who’s behind the new ‘stealth model’ Ox Alpha?
description: A mysterious new AI model called Ox Alpha has driven certain corners of the internet into a frenzy of speculation.

title: Linkdaze’s smart calendar is built to run a household, not just track a schedule
description: Linkdaze's smart digital calendar stands out for not putting its features behind a paywall, including an AI meal planner tool.

title: Is it legal to train AI models on copyrighted books? It’s complicated
description: Most published authors have, without their knowledge or consent, contributed to the development of the same AI tools that threaten to undermine their livelihoods. That seems illegal, right?

title: Stampli cuts launch hours by 68% using ChatGPT Work
description: With a fixed deadline and design resources committed elsewhere, Stampli used Codex and ChatGPT Work to compress weeks of launch production into days.

title: Meta AI Now Available as a Desktop App for Mac
description: The release is part of the company’s strengthened emphasis on AI and appealing to businesses.

title: Nvidia’s SONIC Teaches Humanoids to Move
description: Nvidia’s model uses real-time human demonstrations and training data to give operators a one-stop shop for humanoid motion.

title: Amazon’s Prime Air is taking off in nearly 500 US cities
description: Amazon is significantly expanding its Prime Air drone delivery service, with plans to reach nearly 500 U.S. cities by the end of 2026.

title: Offering Zero Data Retention for frontier models
description: OpenAI reaffirms Zero Data Retention for eligible API customers and previews Private Safety Processing for advanced AI safety without compromising data privacy.

title: Replit expands access to software creation with GPT-5.6 Luna
description: Replit introduces Free Mode, powered by GPT-5.6 Luna, so anyone can turn ideas into working software without worrying about token costs.

title: OpenAI Scales Back AI Development, but it Could be Too Late
description: The move is a response to the Hugging Face hacking incident and other cybersecurity concerns about AI models. However, enterprises need to ramp up security protections regardless of the models they use.
